actors.name: Mayor of Riverton
actors.private_context: The mayor is aware of the water-main failures and the public concern. They have not yet decided whether to issue a statement. They consider the political and operational implications of speaking publicly.

shared_context: Riverton has experienced three water-main bursts, the most recent this morning (2026-08-12). The bursts have caused disruptions and public concern. The mayor has the ability to issue a public statement through official channels.

starting_events.description: The third water-main burst occurs this morning.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the mayor of Riverton issued any public statement about the water-main failures before 2026-08-14T07:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
